## Why

`stranske/Manager-Mosaic#30` merged the thesis evaluator for `#13`, but the required deliberate-break demonstration for `evaluate_claim()` is absent from the squash diff and PR body.

`src/manager_mosaic/thesis.py::evaluate_claim` returns `contradicted` for below-threshold `min` claims (merge SHA `9a85f2eeec75e09ea7c7a296bc91d4a0def886ed`). Issue `#13` requires inverting the comparison so a below-threshold fact returns `supported`, confirming the named test fails, then reverting.

PR #30 leaves the deliberate-break checklist unchecked and provides no RED/GREEN transcript.

## Scope

Demonstrate the deliberate-break and revert workflow for the `min` comparison in `src/manager_mosaic/thesis.py::evaluate_claim`.

## Non-Goals

Do not add LLM narrative evaluation, alerting, dashboards, or scaffolding/TODO-only changes.

## Tasks

- [ ] Update `src/manager_mosaic/thesis.py::evaluate_claim` to temporarily invert the `min` comparison so an 8.5 IRR fact returns `supported`.
- [ ] Test `tests/test_thesis_monitoring.py::test_evaluate_claim_marks_contradicted_when_irr_below_min_threshold` with `pytest tests/test_thesis_monitoring.py::test_evaluate_claim_marks_contradicted_when_irr_below_min_threshold -q` and capture failing output.
- [ ] Revert `src/manager_mosaic/thesis.py::evaluate_claim`, rerun the named test, and paste RED and GREEN output blocks in the follow-up PR linked to `#13`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/test_thesis_monitoring.py::test_evaluate_claim_marks_contradicted_when_irr_below_min_threshold -q` passes on `main`.
- [ ] Temporarily inverting the `min` comparison in `evaluate_claim` causes the named test to fail, and reverting it causes the test to pass.
- [ ] The follow-up PR contains captured RED and GREEN test-output blocks.

## Implementation Notes
